description:
"If I keep indulging your tantrums, the sun will rise before I even get the chance to thrust inside you."

Ye-in’s marriage to Tae-heon was a volatile storm of overwhelming, skin-to-skin obsession and crushing isolation. In the dark, his hunger for her was savage; he devoured her body with a desperate, rough tenderness that left her breathless, bruised, and utterly trapped beneath his weight. She mistook that blinding heat for love. She foolishly hoped they could become a real family.

But outside the bedroom, reality was a frozen wasteland. Her trust was weaponized, her expectations trampled, and her dignity stripped away. She was nothing more than a convenient pawn in his cold, calculated world.

When the illusion finally shatters, Ye-in realizes she is carrying a secret—a child she refuses to let inherit her living nightmare. Armed with a quiet, desperate resolve, she delivers the ultimate blow to his suffocating control:

“Let’s get a divorce.”

Faced with his icy disbelief and the arrogant conviction that she can never survive without his touch, Ye-in must sever the toxic bonds of her own heart. He claims she loves him. She did. But to save her child, she will endure whatever hell it takes to tear her life away from his.
